name: One Ship, Two Ships, Three Ships...
description: Linling forgot to count the number of ships docked at the port yesterday, and it's been troubling her...

dialogs.content: Shoot, I can't remember... Two — no, four, plus... seven...? Nope, that wasn't it...
Ugh! This is such a waste of my time!
What are you counting?
I'm totaling up the number of boats that came into and went out of the docks yesterday... If I get the wrong figures again I'll never hear the end of it!
I was so busy writing poetry yesterday that I totally forgot about it... and now I'm rushing to get this done at the last minute.
I hate doing this. How do they expect me to keep track when there's an endless stream of ships going in and out of the docks all day long? For each one I note down there's another that I miss.
And 'cause I have to count all these boats, then check and double-check the numbers, I now have no time to work on my poetry... It is really ruining my day!
...I know! Maybe you can help me count up yesterday's boats? I need to know how many came in and how many went out.
Okay.
Yay! Thanks!
...I was supposed to have a colleague helping, but...
Ooh, ooh, I have an idea! There's these three kids who I always see playing down by the docks.
I bet you they'll remember how many boats came and went yesterday...
That said, they are only kids. So to be on the safe side, you should ask all three of them and check their stories match.
Well then. I will leave you to interrogate the minors and report back to me when you're done. Over and out.
As long as it's ten or under...
Oh please! You have toes, don't you? Anything up to and including twenty and you have no grounds to complain!
I know I can count on you!
What are we gonna play today...
Hello! What are you doing?
Cast your mind back to yesterday...
Yesterday? Hmm... I only remember <color=#00E1FFFF>one big boat came in yesterday morning</color>.
Fei said it was definitely a Millelith boat and Meng thought it might be a cargo boat.
But I think it looked so amazing it must have been a Liyue Qixing boat.
Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.
Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!
Boys are so dumb...
Oh, hi! What're you up to?
I'm just here to ask a few questions...
Erm... I can't remember. Wait... I think <color=#00E1FFFF>two boats came in yesterday morning</color>.
They were only small boats and they didn't look like most of the ones in the city...
Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.
Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!
Hello! Have you come to play with us?
...You're not here to play games, are you?
I'm here about what you saw yesterday...
Yesterday? <color=#00E1FFFF>No boats came in or went out yesterday morning</color>, so the men who work at the docks had nothing to do.
But they still didn't go home. They just kept waiting at the docks all day long.
I don't get it. If they didn't have any work, why didn't they just go home? It's so weird...
Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.
Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!
I'm never gonna get to be the captain...
Hi! Are you looking for me?
How well do you remember yesterday...
Erm, I wasn't really paying attention. I just remember that <color=#00E1FFFF>one big boat went out yesterday at noon</color>.
You wanna know why I only remember what happened at noon?
Meng and Lulu went to buy Lotus Heads yesterday at noon. I stayed here on my own to guard our spot.
Of course I had to guard our spot. Otherwise someone might steal it!
What's wrong? You look confused.
That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.
But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...
What're we playing today?
Oh hi. What's up?
Sir, I just have a few questions...
<color=#00E1FFFF>Two boats came in yesterday at lunchtime</color>.
They were both going really fast. I bet it was an emergency delivery.
That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.
But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...
Hmph, when will it be my turn...
Oh. Hi. Are you looking for me?
Boats. Yesterday. What can you tell me?
I don't really remember. No wait... I did notice <color=#00E1FFFF>3 boats came in yesterday at noon</color>.
And then loads of people went over to unload all the stuff... The sailors made us get out of the way.
That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.
But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...
I can't wait till I'm a grown up...
Oh hi. You need something?
I need to know what you witnessed yesterday...
The boats? If I remember right, <color=#00E1FFFF>no boats came in or went out yesterday evening</color>.
And I have a good memory. I know what I saw.
Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!
Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...
When I grow up, I wanna travel the whole world...
Oh, hello. What're you doing here?
I need to know what you saw yesterday...
Yesterday... Uh... I'm sorry, I just remember <color=#00E1FFFF>1 boat went out yesterday evening</color>.
Yesterday morning I went to go pick some Lotus Heads for Lulu and Fei.
But I lost track of time and it was already evening when I got back...
I don't think it was a waste though. 'Cause Lulu and Fei got to eat Lotus Heads, didn't they?
Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!
Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...
I wish there was a way I could grow up faster...
Hello! What are you doing today?
Counting boats. About that...
Hmm, lemme think... I just remember <color=#00E1FFFF>3 boats came in yesterday evening</color>.
The boats had really bright lights on, and there were loads of people at the dock. I think they were all waiting for those boats.
Lulu and Fei went home, but I stayed to watch those boats for ages.
If you could get on a boat like that... Surely you could go anywhere you wanted to...
Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!
Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...
Did you interrogate the minors?
Sure did.
Great. So? What are the figures?
8 boats entered.
8 boats entered the docks? Hmm... Y'know what, I think that sounds about right!
Thanks so much! Here's a little something for your trouble, detective!
Right. Now that's sorted, it's time to get back to my magnum opus...

7 boats entered the docks? Hmm... That doesn't sound right.
Never mind, it's close enough I guess. Here's your compensation.
At least now I can get back to working on my magnum opus...
